pages.title: Insights
pages.verdict: Source-grounded reports in the shared PAGE_WIDTH frame. URL-backed category navigation, private saved results and provenance; no fabricated empty-state forecasts. Rendered at 1280px desktop and 390px mobile with real local routes, stores and queue over synthetic provider data; see docs/development/routines-demo.md and docs/demos/routines/.

pages.title: Routines
pages.verdict: Capped settings frame and wrapping row actions. Creation requires an explicit account and scheduled-read consent; next run, pause/resume, revision-safe edits, delete confirmation and saved-result links are visible. Rendered at 1280px desktop and 390px mobile with real local routes, stores and queue over synthetic provider data; see docs/development/routines-demo.md and docs/demos/routines/.

pages.title: Chat landing
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Already close to ai-chat-landing. Three small corrections.

ops.text: Put the 12px inset on the suggestion grid instead of the composer, and set PAGE_WIDTH to 848 so the composer stays 800px.
Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding L9). Show the greeting as a small supporting label, so 'Where should we start?' is the only heading.
The empty space above the phone composer comes from the template's own vAlign=center. Leave it, or make it a product decision.

pages.title: Conversation
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Same ChatLayout frame as ai-chat. Missing the title bar and readable tool calls.

ops.text: Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding H6). Title bar: a Toolbar with the conversation title as the h1, the Cardputer control and a MoreMenu of conversation actions at the end.
On phone, fold the header actions (Cardputer included) into one MoreMenu with sections.
Give tool calls a verb and a target ('Checked agenda · This week') instead of the function name.
Day dividers in long conversations.
Divider before Delete in the conversation menu.

pages.title: Space thread
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Must be the same surface as the conversation. Share the title bar and composer rules.

ops.text: One placeholder rule for every composer: 'Message <destination>'. Drop the 'press @' hint.
Move the audience line out of the composer stack into the title bar as a one-line subtitle; use the same Toolbar as the conversation.
Below 768px drop DeviceHeaderControl from the bar; the thread MoreMenu already has the same items.
New thread: the empty state's action is a Button that opens /threads/new, not an auto-focused form inside the EmptyState.

pages.title: Shell, sidebar and drawer
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Already the shell-side-nav template, plus one extra padding wrapper that causes the double gutter.

ops.text: Delete the shell's VStack padding={6}; each page's Layout owns the gutter.
Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding L11). Give nav rows an href (keep onClick for client routing) so they are links.
Footer = account row + a Settings item linking to /account. Appearance moves to the Account page.
When Spaces fail to load, show a disabled row saying so instead of nothing.
Collapse to the icon rail below 1024px through the already-controlled navCollapsed.
Show the palette shortcut on the Search row.

pages.title: Command palette
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Right component, incomplete destinations.

ops.text: Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding M7). Build Go to from the sidebar's NAV_ITEMS (DRY), plus Account and one item per space.

pages.title: Notifications
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Rows carry too little, and the dialog lives in the wrong place.

ops.text: Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding H2). Mount the dialog beside AppShell, opened by an event like the palette; use a BottomSheet on phone.
Group rows by type with a count: 21 'Security notice' rows become one 'Security notice (21)'.
Add a relative time to every row (needs created_at in the API DTO; the store already has it).
Badge reads '8 unread' to screen readers.

pages.title: Calendar and Agenda
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Two views of the same data that use different words, markers and week starts.

ops.text: One overdue marker everywhere: a red Token over a relative Timestamp, stacked in endContent.
Overdue group first, then days; a compact 'All clear' empty state.
Same week start (weekStartsOn=mon) and one label for the primary action on both surfaces.
Event dialog: pair Starts/Ends in a responsive Grid and divide the groups.
Read-only event view: label When / Where / Notes.
One DayLabel shared by Calendar and Agenda instead of two copies.

pages.title: Space tasks
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Right list, wrong row actions and grouping.

ops.text: One MoreMenu per row (Edit, divider, Delete) instead of pencil + trash.
Group Overdue (n) / Open (n) / Completed (n) and mark overdue rows.
Quick-add is title only; due date and assignee live in the task dialog.
Checklist progress and followers as avatars in the task dialog; fullscreen on phone.
Every form dialog: Layout height=fill and one FormLayout; validate on submit instead of a disabled Save.
ops.where: task-edit-dialog.tsx:267-319 and the event, reminder and new-space dialogs

pages.title: Space notes
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Fine data, buried editor.

ops.text: Notes/Trash switch and search on one wrapping row.
Open a note in place of the list with a '← Notes' Toolbar back button.

pages.title: Space header and members
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Tabs overflow on phone, archive can't be undone, member rows say too little.

ops.text: On narrow screens keep the first tabs and put the rest under 'More'.
Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding H1). Mount the existing ArchivedSpaces list (spaces nav or Account) so an owner can restore.
Delete the dead space-actions.tsx; space-header.tsx already owns the Rename/Archive dialogs.
Member rows: Avatar, email or handle as description, Remove/Leave/Make owner in a MoreMenu; a heading with Invite as its action.
New space: a visible, explained choice of kind.

pages.title: Memory
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Hand-built rows with too many visible actions.

ops.text: Rows as List/ListItem: description 'kind · source · time', whole row links to its conversation.
Row actions into one MoreMenu; 'Delete all' into the header menu after a divider.
No-match state with a Clear filter action; partial results as a warning Banner with Load more.
Section headings carry a hint and a count instead of repeating the page title.

pages.title: Devices and pairing
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. The biggest single win: a list that opens one device, instead of every device fully open.

ops.text: A device list (name, model · last seen, StatusDot, MoreMenu) that drills into the existing DeviceHome with a back Toolbar. PAGE_WIDTH 872 is below the template's 900px split, so drill-in at every width.
Online/Offline as a StatusDot (Badge is for counts); 'Now talking in' as a secondary label, not accent red.
Device facts as a labelled list.
Empty state offers 'Pair a device'.
/pair: remove the Card now; then a vertical inline Stepper (Code → Look up → Approve) with a MetadataList review.

pages.title: Google accounts (Settings)
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. One connector today; shape it so the catalog can grow (#584) without a redesign.

ops.text: Each connector a ClickableCard in a Grid; the whole tile is the target.
Search and category filters only once there are more than about 8 connectors (YAGNI).
Gmail rows: a labelled 'Disconnect' ghost button instead of a trash icon; correct read-failure copy.

pages.title: Account
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Use the settings-sidebar row pattern: show the value, edit in place.

ops.text: Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding M4). Name and time zone as rows that show the value and expand to the field with Save/Cancel; no always-on Save.
Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding M4). Password, Export and Devices as one-line rows with a small action, separated by Dividers.
Historical proposal; resolved by current implementation (see finding M10). 'Sign out everywhere' moves here as a row, confirmed by AlertDialog.
Delete account as a row; the typed confirm only appears once expanded.
Appearance section here, System/Light/Dark as a SegmentedControl.

pages.title: Sign-in, reset and invite
pages.verdict: Historical assessment; consult dated findings for current status. Three different shells for one kind of screen, and two dead ends.

ops.text: Reset and invite reuse sign-in's AuthShell (mark + Card) instead of their own shells.
Every terminal state gets a ghost exit: Cancel, Back to sign in, Go to Bob, Use a different account.
Invalid invite: one heading plus supporting text, not a heading and a Banner saying the same thing.
Sign-in: an 'Or' divider before the alternatives; a wrong password shown on the field.

pages.title: Converse and voice controls
pages.verdict: No standalone Converse route; controls live in shared chat. Requires mocked browser permission/transport states, no actual microphone or production requests.

pages.verdict: 2026-10-17: fictional populated directory and confirmation verified at320/359/390/1280 light/dark. Counts distinguish enabled/disabled and confirmation subset. No production mutations.

pages.title: My Apps
pages.verdict: Astryx library header and dashboard spacing in the shared PAGE_WIDTH frame. Native allowlisted JSON views share saved records; schema changes preview before apply, record editors preserve conflicts, scheduled task-table replacement requires consent. Marketing reuses ChatSurface and its composer with network and distinct post/campaign intent, native draft cards, workspace-scoped pending edits, locked in-flight saves, stable retries, conflict-preserving forms, typed configuration preview and explicit apply/history. Manual reload refreshes Marketing reads without remounting pending edits. Schedule and metrics remain unavailable. Marketing browser verification is tracked in bob-apps-marketing.e2e.ts; generic app coverage remains in bob-apps.e2e.ts.
